name: StagingBar - Reviewing Before Publish
description: The review drawer, captured because this feature narrowed StagingBar's phase enum. `phase` used to carry a 'deploying' member and sit on it for the whole GitHub Pages build; the deploy now lives in its own state beside the publish flow, leaving idle / reviewing / committing / error. This is the state that proves the remaining flow still works — two staged changes still group by area and 'Publish 2 changes' is still reachable. Two areas rather than one so the grouping is visible.
